steps.en: Load Raphaël and flowchart.js on the page, e.g. from CDNJS
steps.zh: 在页面里引入 Raphaël 和 flowchart.js，比如走 CDNJS

steps.en: Write the chart as text: node definitions, then the connections
steps.zh: 把图写成文本：先定义节点，再写连线

steps.en: Parse the text and draw it into a container element
steps.zh: 解析这段文本，画进一个容器元素

steps.en: Parses the DSL into typed nodes and the edges between them
steps.zh: 把 DSL 解析成带类型的节点和它们之间的边

steps.en: Lays the nodes out and draws shapes and arrows as SVG via Raphaël
steps.zh: 排好节点位置，通过 Raphaël 画出 SVG 图形和箭头

value.en: The flowchart lives as diffable text next to your docs — no drawing tool to open
value.zh: 流程图就是一段能 diff 的文本，跟文档放在一起，不用打开画图工具
